limits: One run of a guided extraction task; no estimate of reliability over the full lexicon.
Identifiers, construction definitions, and queries were supplied; schema design and exhaustive discovery were not tested.
The model extracted manuscript claims; this is not independent verification of those grammatical claims.
Retain query context: P17 concerns bare singular count book, not all independent NPs headed by book. Some conditions remain prose rather than executable predicates.
